units.name: Engineering Technology Department
units.evidence: The official Engineering Management master’s page explicitly identifies its department chair and teaches Operations and Systems Management, Quality Assurance and Process Improvement, Engineering Decision Analysis, and Operations & Supply Chain Management. The complete Science and Technology overview places Engineering Management in Engineering Technology. This establishes a relevant current department, not a doctoral programme.
